house.description: Source of income discrimination by landlords prohibited.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Judiciary Finance and Civil Law
Authors added Coulter, Smith, Agbaje and Kraft

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to human rights; prohibiting source of income discrimination in housing; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 363A.09, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 363A.09, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 7.+]

[+Discrimination; housing assistance.+]

[+A landlord shall not discriminate against a tenant based on the tenant's use of federal, state, or local government rental assistance; a housing choice voucher program; or another form of public assistance that helps a tenant pay rent. A landlord shall not deny a tenant or prospective tenant a viewing of a rental unit or application for a rental unit, deny them the opportunity to rent a unit, or discriminate against a tenant or prospective tenant who uses rental assistance or a housing choice voucher. A landlord shall not advertise that the landlord will not rent to a tenant who uses rental assistance or a housing choice voucher program. +]
